Includes vertical/horizontal modes, label options, smooth animations, overlay styling, and full responsiveness.

View Demo

Blob Shapes â€“ A creative Elementor widget that generates organic, fluid-shaped blobs for modern website designs. Can be used as decorative elements, background highlights, image masks, or graphic accents in hero sections. Supports random shape generation, color controls, gradient backgrounds, SVG output, and full styling options to match your brand theme.

View Demo

Flip Card â€“ An interactive Elementor widget where the card flips on hover or click to reveal additional content. Ideal for service listings, team profiles, features, pricing boxes, or promotional content. Includes front/back design controls, flip directions, 3D animations, icons, images, and full typography customization.

6. Image Accordion

View Demo

Image Accordion â€“ A modern Elementor accordion made entirely of images. Expands smoothly on hover or click, revealing titles, descriptions, and call-to-action buttons. PDF Viewer â€“ A convenient Elementor widget that displays PDF files directly on your webpage. Perfect for documents, menus, brochures, reports, forms, catalogs, or manuals. Mega Menu â€“ An advanced Elementor navigation widget for creating professional mega menus with multiple columns, rich content, and custom layouts. Ideal for large e-commerce sites, corporate websites, and complex navigation structures. Supports image integration, custom widgets, submenu hierarchies, hover effects, responsive mobile menus, search functionality, and advanced styling options. Enhances user experience with organized, visually appealing menu systems that improve site navigation.

View Demo

Post Timeline â€“ The Post Timeline widget lets you create stunning vertical and horizontal timelines directly inside Elementor â€” no coding required. Whether you’re building a company history, a blog post archive, a product roadmap, or a step-by-step process, this widget handles it all with flexible source options and rich styling controls.

Perfect for blog posts and discussion-based content requiring engaging user interaction.

Includes support for attention-grabbing headlines, persuasive descriptions, customizable buttons, background images, gradient overlays, and animated elements. Ideal for landing pages, promotional sections, lead generation campaigns, and marketing funnels with multiple layout variations.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/softech-addons-for-elementor directory, or install it through the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to Elementor Editor and explore the new widgets.
  5. If you have any questions, please check out the FAQ page or contact us via our Contact form.
sections.faq:
If something isn’t addressed here, how can we connect with you?

You’re welcome to message us anytime using our Contact form.

Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. All widgets, including the Mega Menu, work completely with the free version of Elementor. As of version 1.1.2, we have introduced our own built-in Theme Builder, so you no longer need Elementor Pro’s Theme Builder to place your Mega Menu (or any other widget) in your site’s header or footer. Simply use our Header & Footer Builder from the plugin settings Theme Builder tab to design and assign your header and footer templates â€” no Elementor Pro subscription required.

Where can I find the new widgets after installation?

Once activated, the new widgets (like Loop Grid slider, Testimonial Slider, Before After Slider, etc.) will appear in the Elementor Editor panel under a dedicated section called “Widgets”.

Will your plugin affect the performance of my site?

We run tests to ensure the speed of the site is not affected when you activate our Elementor addons. We provide a way for you to deactivate those Elementor modules that you do not require for your site to avoid loading them unnecessarily on the pages.

Does it work with any theme?

YES! It will work with any theme where Elementor works.

What if I update to Premium version?

Your existing Elementor elements & content will work with premium version. So you won’t lose your developed contents or any elementor elements.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • New Feature: Built-in Theme Builder for Header & Footer â€“ Introduced our own custom Header & Footer Builder, completely eliminating the dependency on Elementor Pro’s Theme Builder. You can now design and assign header and footer templates directly from the plugin, using the free version of Elementor.
  • Mega Menu: Now fully functional in site headers and footers without requiring Elementor Pro. Works seamlessly with the new built-in Header & Footer Builder.
  • New Plugin: Introduced companion plugin Post Timeline â€“ a dedicated WordPress timeline widget for displaying posts in beautiful vertical and horizontal timeline layouts.
  • Compatibility: Improved overall compatibility and stability across all widgets with the new header/footer system.
  • Code Quality: Refactored header/footer registration and rendering logic for better performance and maintainability.
  • Theme Builder: Configure header and footer designs and control where they appear using display conditions.

1.1.1

  • Security: Clarified and hardened frontend output handling for Elementor-rendered content to align with best practices and avoid potential XSS warnings
  • Code Quality: Added explicit documentation and PHPCS directives where Elementor output is intentionally unescaped
  • Stability: Minor internal refactoring with no functional or UI changes
  • Compatibility: Improved compatibility with security scanners and code review tools
  • Maintenance: General cleanup and consistency improvements across Stripe and frontend rendering logic

1.1.0

  • Major Performance Improvements: Implemented unified caching layer to significantly reduce database queries and improve page load times
  • Optimization: Refactored testimonial widget queries with intelligent caching for faster template loading
  • Enhancement: Improved helper function performance with proper cache management for pro widgets information
  • Database: Added strategic indexes to payment tables for faster query execution and improved data retrieval
  • Security: Implemented rate limiting on payment endpoints to prevent abuse and enhance transaction security
  • Asset Management: Fixed asset registration pattern across all widgets to prevent redundant loading and improve efficiency
  • Code Quality: Removed unnecessary init hooks from Stripe Checkout widget, reducing server overhead
  • Styling: Moved inline CSS to external files for better caching and faster subsequent page loads
  • Image Optimization: Added lazy loading attributes to all widget images for improved initial page load performance
  • Developer Tools: Added performance monitoring class for debugging and optimization tracking
  • Overall: Achieved 40â€“60% improvement in page load speeds through comprehensive optimization techniques

1.0.3

  • Blob Shapes: Added color and shadow controls, along with minor bug fixes.
  • Flip Card: Fixed issues with description content not displaying correctly.
  • Number Box: Improved layout structure and fixed widget title settings issues.
  • Image Accordion: Added a limit option for the number of images and resolved minor bugs.
  • Mega Menu: Updated layout styling and fixed submenu-related issues.
  • Stripe Checkout: Success and failed shortcodes can now be used together on the same page; minor issues resolved.
  • Loop Grid Slider: Fixed grid column layout issues and resolved arrow icon rendering problems.
  • Before After Slider: Added direction control with both horizontal and vertical modes, introduced hover and click trigger options, and added new styling controls.

1.0.2

  • New Widgets: Stripe Checkout, Mega Menu
  • Improvements: Bug Fixes, Compatibility upgraded
  • Enhancements: Improved widget stability and performance
  • Documentation: Added comprehensive descriptions for new widgets

1.0.1

  • Improvements: Bug Fixes, Compatibility upgraded

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Widgets: Before After Slider, Loop Grid Slider, Image Accordion, Testimonial Slider, Blob Shapes, Number Box, Dual Color Heading, PDF Viewer, Flip Card
